patch.summary: Slack cost guide: researched plan structure, free/trial flags, who each tier suits, cost scenarios, and value tradeoffs — no invented prices.

blocks.body: Slack pricing is plan-gated across 4 researched tiers. Free entry: Free. Trial/free path present in researched plans. Compare seat/capacity gates and unlocks — not list-price folklore.
bullets: Trial/free path present in researched plans

blocks.title: Slack plan matrix and who each tier suits
blocks.body: Structure and trial/free flags come from SoftwareGlimpse pricing research. Dollar amounts appear only when verified — never invent list prices.

lines.description: Free plan · Unlocks: shared inbox, team messaging, video meetings · Suits: explore before committing seats

blocks.heading: Slack cost scenarios to pressure-test
blocks.body: Price Slack against how you actually buy seats and unlocks — not against a competitor's homepage headline.

scenarios.title: Lean team / free-or-trial first
scenarios.body: Stay on Free until a gated capability (AI assistance (Free, Pro, Business+, Enterprise+)) becomes mandatory.

scenarios.title: Growing team with gated workflows
scenarios.body: Map must-have workflows (shared inbox, team messaging, video meetings) to plan unlocks before expanding seats.

scenarios.title: Hidden / extra cost watch
scenarios.body: Budget risk: Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer. Also check add-ons, overages, and admin time outside the sticker plan.

steps.label: Pay up when Knowledge-worker teams that need channel-based team messaging as the primary collaboration hub requires a paid unlock you will use weekly
Do not overbuy if this limitation dominates: Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer

items.title: Cost trap 1
items.body: Not a business phone system — no cloud phone, call routing, recording or power dialer

items.title: Cost trap 2
items.body: No SMS or WhatsApp Business customer channels

items.title: Cost trap 3
items.body: Video is limited to huddles / meeting integrations rather than a full meetings suite

items.title: Cost trap 5
items.body: Analytics are limited on Free/Pro relative to enterprise admin suites

blocks.title: Cheaper or clearer alternatives to pressure-test
blocks.body: Compare total cost of ownership vs Slack on identical constraints.

blocks.body: Use researched plan structure for Slack alongside category cost modelling.
